title: Sea of Stars

outfit_card.silhouette: A voluminous strapless ballgown with a corseted bodice and a dramatic, layered tulle skirt, accented by detached opera gloves and a sheer, star-strewn overlay that creates a celestial, flowing silhouette.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate gold star-shaped hairpin with dangling, star-tipped chains on the left side, and a large, radiant golden starburst ornament floating near the hair.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Bodice of deep violet silk with a sweetheart neckline, trimmed in scalloped lace and gold filigree. The bodice is boned and features a jeweled pendant. Detached, elbow-length gloves in sheer, dark purple tulle.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A full, tiered ballgown skirt in layers of purple tulle and organza, adorned with scattered golden star appliqués and a subtle, shimmering underskirt. The hem is finished with a delicate lace edge.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A floating, radiant golden starburst prop with a glowing core. Scattered, floating golden star motifs and a faint, ethereal starry haze that surrounds the figure.
